services.name: Home page
services.description: A static home page built to your design, responsive on phones, tablets and desktops.

services.name: Additional page
services.description: One more static page, such as About, Services or Contact.

services.name: Prototype
services.description: A clickable site mockup made before development. Use it to review the layout and user flow, then resolve feedback before the build starts.
services.note: The price is a default. Set the real price per quote.

services.name: Sanity CMS setup
services.description: Sets up Sanity so your team can create and edit content without changing code. Includes the Studio, content types and deployment.

services.name: Content schema
services.description: Defines one CMS content type and its fields, such as a blog post, team member or product.
services.note: The price is a default. Set the real price per quote.

services.name: Visual editing
services.description: Lets editors select text or images on the live site and edit them in Sanity.

services.name: Dynamic listing page
services.description: Displays a CMS collection, such as blog posts, team members or portfolio projects. New entries appear without a code change.

services.name: Dynamic detail page
services.description: Builds the template for one entry in a CMS collection, such as a blog post, team profile or product.
services.note: The price is a default. Set the real price per quote.

services.name: Formspree contact form
services.description: Sends contact form submissions to your email through Formspree.
services.note: Requires a Formspree account. Subscription fees are separate.

services.name: Custom contact form
services.description: Builds a contact form without a form service. Stores submissions in your CMS and sends notifications through Resend.
services.note: Requires a Resend account.

services.name: Third-party API integration
services.description: Connects the site to an API, such as a CRM, inventory system or booking platform.
services.note: Price depends on the API and the required work.

services.name: Payment integration
services.description: Adds online payments through Stripe or another gateway, including checkout, confirmation and webhook handling.
services.note: The provider charges transaction fees separately.

services.name: Deployment
services.description: Deploys the site to its live URL, connects your domain and configures automatic deploys from code changes.

services.name: Cloudflare setup
services.description: Connects your domain to Cloudflare for CDN delivery, DDoS protection, HTTPS and DNS management.
services.note: Requires a Cloudflare account.

services.name: Professional email setup
services.description: Sets up domain email through Zoho Mail, including DNS records and mailbox creation.
services.note: Zoho fees are separate.

services.name: Transactional email
services.description: Sends emails triggered by site actions, such as form confirmations, booking receipts or password resets, through Resend.
services.note: Requires a Resend account.

services.name: Email template
services.description: Designs an HTML email for newsletters, notifications or receipts and tests it in Gmail, Outlook and Apple Mail.

services.name: On-page SEO
services.description: Adds page titles, meta descriptions, social sharing tags, canonical URLs and an XML sitemap for Google Search Console.

services.name: Structured data
services.description: Adds JSON-LD markup for eligible Google results, such as ratings, FAQs, breadcrumbs or events.

services.name: Analytics setup
services.description: Sets up Google Analytics 4 for traffic and conversions, then connects Google Search Console for indexing and search data.
services.note: Both services are free.

services.name: Maintenance retainer
services.description: Monthly maintenance for updates, security checks, minor content fixes and priority support after launch.

services.name: Content migration
services.description: Moves text, images and documents from an existing site or platform.
services.note: Price depends on the amount and format of the content.

services.name: Extra revision round
services.description: One more round of design changes after the included revisions.

services.name: Photo gallery
services.description: A responsive gallery with lightbox viewing for rooms, dishes, events or projects.

services.name: Map and location
services.description: Embeds a map with directions, opening hours and a click-to-call link.

services.name: Booking request form
services.description: Collects the date, time or dates, party size and contact details, and emails the request to your team through Resend.
services.note: Requires a Resend account.

services.name: Booking system integration
services.description: Connects the site to a booking system such as Beds24, Cloudbeds or Calendly, with live availability and a branded booking flow.
services.note: The booking system charges its own subscription fees. The price is a default. Set the real price per quote.

services.name: Additional language
services.description: Translates the site structure and templates into one more language, with a language switcher and localized URLs.
services.note: Translated text is supplied by you.

services.name: Google Business Profile setup
services.description: Creates or claims your Google listing and fills in hours, photos, categories and links to the site.

services.name: WhatsApp chat button
services.description: Adds a floating button that opens a WhatsApp chat with a prefilled message.

services.name: Reviews widget
services.description: Shows selected customer reviews from Google on the site.

services.name: Page copywriting
services.description: Writes the text for one page, edited to your brand voice and search terms.

services.name: Photo optimization
services.description: Resizes, compresses and crops a batch of photos so pages load fast.

services.name: Cart and checkout
services.description: A product or item list with a cart, checkout, payment and order notification emails.
services.note: The price is a default. Set the real price per quote.

services.name: User accounts and login
services.description: Sign-up, login, password reset and session handling for your application.

services.name: Role-based access
services.description: Limits what each type of user can see and change, such as admin, staff and customer.

services.name: Admin dashboard
services.description: A back office where your team manages users, records and settings.

services.name: Data module
services.description: Builds one record type end to end, with database table, API, list and edit screens.
services.note: The price is a default. Set the real price per quote.

services.name: File uploads
services.description: Lets users upload, store and download files, with size and type limits.

services.name: Reports and export
services.description: Summary reports with filters, plus CSV and PDF export.

services.name: Subscription billing
services.description: Recurring plans with trials, upgrades, cancellations and invoice emails.
services.note: The payment provider charges transaction fees separately.

services.name: Automated tests and CI
services.description: Unit and end-to-end tests that run on every code change before deploy.

services.name: Development day
services.description: One day of development for work outside the listed services.

services.name: Discovery workshop
services.description: A working session to define goals, users, scope and priorities, with a written summary.

services.name: Technical spec and roadmap
services.description: A written specification with features, data model, tech choices and a phased delivery plan.

services.name: Launch QA
services.description: Tests the finished product across devices and browsers and fixes what it finds before launch.

services.name: Handover docs and training
services.description: Written documentation and a live session that teach your team to run the product.

services.name: Support hour
services.description: One hour of support or small changes outside a maintenance plan.

services.name: Static site hosting
services.description: Hosts a static site on Cloudflare with SSL, global CDN and automatic deploys.

services.name: Application hosting
services.description: Hosts an application with its database and storage on Cloudflare, including SSL and deploys.

services.name: Uptime monitoring
services.description: Checks the site every few minutes and alerts us if it goes down.

services.name: Backups
services.description: Daily automated backups of your database and files, kept for 30 days.

services.name: Maintenance light
services.description: Monthly dependency and security updates, plus one hour of content edits.

services.name: Maintenance priority
services.description: Monthly updates and security checks, same-day response and five hours of changes.

services.name: Workspace mailbox
services.description: A Google Workspace mailbox on your domain.
services.note: Billed at cost plus handling.

services.name: Domain registration, .com
services.description: Registers or renews a .com domain for one year.
services.note: Approximate registrar cost. Confirm before quoting.

services.name: Domain registration, .lk
services.description: Registers or renews a .lk domain for one year.
services.note: Approximate registrar cost. Confirm before quoting.

packages.name: Landing page
packages.description: A single page with a contact form, ready to launch and be found. Good for a campaign, an event or a new business.

packages.name: Starter site
packages.description: A five page site with a contact form and the SEO basics. Good for a small business that needs to be online.

packages.name: Business site
packages.description: A six page site that your team can edit, with visual editing, your own contact form and a business email address.

packages.name: Online store
packages.description: A site that takes payments and sends order emails, with a cart, checkout and a branded confirmation email.

packages.name: Prototype sprint
packages.description: A discovery session and three clickable screens, so you can test an idea before paying for a build.

packages.name: Idea blueprint
packages.description: A discovery session, a written spec with roadmap and five clickable screens. You leave with a plan any developer can build.

packages.name: App MVP
packages.description: A first working version of a custom web app, from discovery to launch, with login, an admin dashboard and three data modules.

packages.name: App growth
packages.description: The App MVP with payments, reports, file uploads, two more data modules and automated tests.

packages.name: Hosting only
packages.description: Hosting for a static site with uptime monitoring.

packages.name: Care essential
packages.description: Hosting, monitoring and monthly updates, with one hour of content edits.

packages.name: Care standard
packages.description: Hosting, monitoring, daily backups and the monthly maintenance retainer.

packages.name: Care priority
packages.description: Application hosting, monitoring, backups and priority maintenance with same-day response. Built for custom apps.
